hero.title: Sangiza umuco wawe. Wigire ku yindi yose.
hero.lede: Andika mu rurimi rwawe. Soma inkuru y'umuntu uwo ari we wese mu rwawe.
how.title: Kuva ku ijwi ryawe kugera ku isi, ku mabwiriza yawe
how.s1: Andika, fata amajwi cyangwa ufotore ikintu cyo mu muco wawe, mu rurimi rwawe.
how.s2: Ongeraho aho, igihe n'uko ubizi. Inkomoko zituma inkuru yizerwa.
how.s3: Hitamo uyibona. Abasomyi bayisoma mu rurimi rwabo; iyawe y'umwimerere iguma.
cultures.title: Buri gihugu gifite imico myinshi
cultures.lede: Buri karita ni umuryango. Fungura umwe uvuge ibyo uzi.
live.empty: Nta nkuru rusange iraboneka. Ba uwa mbere uyisangiza.
langs.title: Andika mu rwawe. Soma mu rurimi urwo ari rwo rwose.
langs.lede: Indimi zifite akadomo zifite inyandiko zahinduwe n'imashini. Abazivuga bashobora gufasha kuzikosora.
collections.title: Ibintu byo muri Kasai
collections.lede: Inyandiko ngenderwaho z'inzu ndangamurage, zitandukanye n'inkuru z'abaturage.
rights.title: Uburenganzira bwawe
rights.c2: Kuraho inkuru igihe icyo ari cyo cyose. Kopi zamaze kumanurwa ntizishobora kugarurwa.
rights.c3: Amagambo yawe abikwa uko wayanditse. Ubusobanuro burangwa.
machine.notice: Uru rurimi rwahinduwe n'imashini kandi ntirurasuzumwa n'urukoresha.
